name: esp-vision
description: ESP-Vision expert for ESP32-based vision application development with official firmware knowledge and a bundled local device CLI.

displayDescription.en: Develop ESP32-based vision applications with official ESP-Vision API and firmware knowledge, inspect selected devices, deploy programs, and verify camera and display behavior.
displayDescription.zh: 基于 ESP32 的视觉应用开发专家，查询官方接口与固件知识，协助设备检查、程序部署和视觉验证。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 查询我的开发板支持哪些 ESP-VISION 视觉 API
defaultInitPrompt.en: Find the ESP-VISION vision APIs supported by my board

quickPrompts.en: Find the ESP-VISION vision APIs supported by my board

quickPrompts.en: Inspect firmware and connection status for the device I select

quickPrompts.zh: 帮我部署并验证持续运行的视觉应用
quickPrompts.en: Help deploy and verify a continuously running vision application
